segs.en: Musaf for the Three Festivals
segs.text: מוסף לשלש רגלים
אֲ֭דֹנָי שְׂפָתַ֣י תִּפְתָּ֑ח וּ֝פִ֗י יַגִּ֥יד תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃

בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵֽאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם, אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק, וֵֽאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב. הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא, אֵל עֶלְיוֹן, גּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים, קוֹנֵה הַכֹּל, וְזוֹכֵר חַסְדֵּי אָבוֹת, וּמֵבִיא גוֹאֵל לִבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם לְמַֽעַן שְׁמוֹ בְּאַֽהֲבָה: מֶֽלֶךְ עוֹזֵר וּמוֹשִֽׁיעַ וּמָגֵן: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יַהַוַהַ, מָגֵן אַבְרָהָם:
אַתָּה גִבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי, מְחַיֶּה מֵתִים אַתָּה, רַב לְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ.

מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶֽסֶד, מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים בְּרַֽחֲמִים רַבִּים, סוֹמֵךְ נֽוֹפְלִים, וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים, וּמַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים, וּמְקַיֵּם אֱמֽוּנָתוֹ לִֽישֵׁנֵי עָפָר. מִי כָמֽוֹךָ בַּֽעַל גְּבוּרוֹת, וּמִי דֽוֹמֶה לָךְ, מֶֽלֶךְ מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה וּמַצְמִֽיחַ יְשׁוּעָה. וְנֶֽאֱמָן אַתָּה לְהַֽחֲיוֹת מֵתִים: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יֵהֵוֵהֵ, מְחַיֵּה הַמֵּתִים:

segs.en: In the chazzan's repetition of Musaf on Yom Tov or Shabbat, say:
segs.text: <small>בחזרת הש"ץ במוסף של יו"ט או שבת אומרים</small>

parts.text: עִם עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל קְבוּצֵי מַטָּה. יַחַד כֻּלָּם קְדֻשָּׁה לְךָ יְשַׁלֵּשׁוּ,
כַּדָּבָר הָאָמוּר עַל יַד נְבִיאָךְ וְקָרָ֨א זֶ֤ה אֶל־זֶה֙ וְאָמַ֔ר
קָד֧וֹשׁ ׀ קָד֛וֹשׁ קָד֖וֹשׁ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת מְלֹ֥א כָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃ כְּבוֹדוֹ מָלֵא עוֹלָם,
וּמְשָׁרְתָיו שׁוֹאֲלִים אַיֵּה מְקוֹם כְּבוֹדוֹ לְהַעֲרִיצוֹ: לְעֻמָּתָם מְשַׁבְּחִים וְאוֹמְרִים
מִמְּקוֹמוֹ הוּא יִפֶן בְּרַחֲמָיו לְעַמּוֹ הַמְיַחֲדִים שְׁמוֹ עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר,
בְּכָל יוֹם תָּמִיד אוֹמְרִים פַּעֲמַיִם בְּאַהֲבָה

parts.en: On the word 'echad', intend to be ready to give one's life for the sanctification of the Name.
parts.text: <small>בתיבת אחד יכון שהוא מוכן למסור נפשו על קידוש השם</small>
וְיַשְׁמִיעֵנוּ בְּרַחֲמָיו לְעֵינֵי כָּל חַי לֵאמֹר,
הֵן גָּאַלְתִּי אֶתְכֶם אַחֲרִית כְּרֵאשִׁית לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים,
אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם: וּבְדִבְרֵי קָדְשְׁךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר
יִמְלֹ֤ךְ יְהֹוָ֨ה ׀ לְעוֹלָ֗ם אֱלֹהַ֣יִךְ צִ֭יּוֹן לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֗ר הַֽלְלוּיָֽהּ:

segs.en: In the chazzan's repetition of Musaf on Chol HaMoed, say:
segs.text: <small>בחזרת הש"ץ במוסף של חול המועד אומרים</small>

parts.text: כֶּתֶר יִתְּנוּ לְךָ, יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ, מַלְאָכִים הֲמוֹנֵי מַעְלָה, וְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל קְבוּצֵי מַטָּה. יַחַד כֻּלָּם קְדֻשָּׁה לְךָ יְשַׁלֵּשׁוּ,
<small> כַּדָּבָר הָאָמוּר עַל יַד נְבִיאָךְ וְקָרָ֨א זֶ֤ה אֶל־זֶה֙ וְאָמַ֔ר</small>
קָד֧וֹשׁ ׀ קָד֛וֹשׁ קָד֖וֹשׁ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת מְלֹ֥א כָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃
יִמְלֹ֤ךְ יְהֹוָ֨ה ׀ לְעוֹלָ֗ם אֱלֹהַ֣יִךְ צִ֭יּוֹן לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֗ר הַֽלְלוּיָֽהּ:

segs.text: אַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ וְשִׁמְךָ קָדוֹשׁ, וּקְדוֹשִׁים בְּכָל־יוֹם יְהַֽלְלֽוּךָ סֶּֽלָה: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יֹהֵוָהֵ, הָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ:

אַתָּה בְּחַרְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים, אָהַבְתָּ אוֹתָנוּ וְרָצִיתָ בָּנוּ, וְרוֹמַמְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת, וְקִדַּשְׁתָּנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ, וְקֵרַבְתָּנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶךָ, וְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ עָלֵינוּ קָרָאתָ.

parts.text: אֶת יוֹם טוֹב מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ הַזֶּה,
אֶת יוֹם טוֹב מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה,

segs.text: בְּאַהֲבָה מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ זֵֽכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָֽיִם.

אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, מִפְּנֵי חֲטָאֵינוּ גָּלִינוּ מֵאַרְצֵנוּ, וְנִתְרַחַקְנוּ מֵעַל אַדְמָתֵנוּ, וְאֵין אֲנַחְנוּ יְכוֹלִים לַעֲלוֹת וְלֵרָאוֹת וּלְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֹת לְפָנֶיךָ בְּבֵית בְּחִירָתָךְ, בִּנְוֵה הֲדָרָךְ, בַּבַּיִת הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁנִּקְרָא שִׁמְךָ עָלָיו, מִפְּנֵי הַיָּד שֶׁנִּשְׁתַּלְּחָה בְּמִקְדָּשָׁךְ.

יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, מֶלֶךְ רַחֲמָן, שֶׁתָּשׁוּב וּתְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים, וְתִבְנֵהוּ מְהֵרָה וּתְגַדֵּל כְּבוֹדוֹ. אָבִינוּ, מַלְכֵּנוּ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ, גַּלֵּה כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ עָלֵינוּ מְהֵרָה, וְהוֹפַע וְהִנָּשֵׂא עָלֵינוּ לְעֵינֵי כָל חַי, וְקָרֵב פְּזוּרֵינוּ מִבֵּין הַגּוֹיִם, וּנְפוּצוֹתֵינוּ כַּנֵּס מִיַּרְכְּתֵי אָרֶץ, וַהֲבִיאֵנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְצִיּוֹן עִירָךְ בְּרִנָּה, וְלִירוּשָׁלַיִם עִיר מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּשִׂמְחַת עוֹלָם, אָנָּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ, וְשָׁם נַעֲשֶׂה לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת קָרְבְּנוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵינוּ, תְּמִידִים כְּסִדְרָם וּמוּסָפִים כְּהִלְכָתָם.

parts.text: נַעֲשֶׂה וְנַקְרִיב לְפָנֶיךָ בְּאַהֲבָה כְּמִצְוַת רְצוֹנָךְ,

segs.text: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, מֶלֶךְ רַחֲמָן רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ, טוֹב וּמֵטִיב הִדָּרֶשׁ לָנוּ, שׁוּבָה עָלֵינוּ בַּהֲמוֹן רַחֲמֶיךָ, בִּגְלַל אָבוֹת שֶׁעָשׂוּ רְצוֹנֶךָ, בְּנֵה בֵיתְךָ כְּבַתְּחִלָּה, כּוֹנֵן בֵּית מִקְדָּשְׁךָ עַל מְכוֹנוֹ, הַרְאֵנוּ בְּבִנְיָנוֹ, שַׂמְּחֵנוּ בְּתִקּוּנוֹ, וְהָשֵׁב שְׁכִינָתְךָ לְתוֹכוֹ, וְהָשֵׁב כֹּהֲנִים לַעֲבוֹדָתָם, וּלְוִיִּים לְדוּכָנָם, לְשִׁירָם וּלְזִמְרָם, וְהָשֵׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל לִנְוֵיהֶם. וְשָׁם נַעֲלֶה וְנֵרָאֶה וְנִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לְפָנֶיךָ בְּשָׁלֹשׁ פַּעֲמֵי רְגָלֵינוּ בְּכָל שָׁנָה וְשָׁנָה, כַּכָּתוּב בַּתּוֹרָה שָׁל֣וֹשׁ פְּעָמִ֣ים ׀ בַּשָּׁנָ֡ה יֵרָאֶ֨ה כׇל־זְכוּרְךָ֜ אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י ׀ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ בַּמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִבְחָ֔ר בְּחַ֧ג הַמַּצּ֛וֹת וּבְחַ֥ג הַשָּׁבֻע֖וֹת וּבְחַ֣ג הַסֻּכּ֑וֹת וְלֹ֧א יֵרָאֶ֛ה אֶת־פְּנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה רֵיקָֽם׃ אִ֖ישׁ כְּמַתְּנַ֣ת יָד֑וֹ כְּבִרְכַּ֛ת יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן־לָֽךְ׃
וְהַשִּׂיאֵנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶת בִּרְכַּת מוֹעֲדֶיךָ לְחַיִּים בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְשָׁלוֹם, כַּאֲשֶׁר רָצִיתָ וְאָמַרְתָּ לְבָרְכֵנוּ כֵּן תְּבָרְכֵנוּ סֶלָה.

segs.en: On Shabbat say:
segs.text: <small>בשבת אומרים</small>

parts.text: וְיִשְׂמְחוּ בְךָ כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁמֶךָ.

segs.text: רְצֵה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלִתְפִלָּתָם שְׁעֵה, וְהָשֵׁב הָֽעֲבוֹדָה לִדְבִיר בֵּיתֶֽךָ, וְאִשֵּׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּתְפִלָּתָם, מְהֵרָה בְּאַֽהֲבָה תְקַבֵּל בְּרָצוֹן, וּתְהִי לְרָצוֹן תָּמִיד עֲבוֹדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ: וְאַתָּה בְּרַֽחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים, תַּחְפֹּץ בָּֽנוּ וְתִרְצֵֽנוּ, וְתֶֽחֱזֶֽינָה עֵינֵֽינוּ בְּשֽׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַֽחֲמִים: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יִהִוִהִ, הַמַּֽחֲזִיר שְׁכִֽינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן:

segs.en: In the blessing of 'Modim', bow at 'Modim' and rise at the Name.
segs.text: <small>בברכת "מודים" יכרע ב"מודים" ויזקוף בשם <small>(בא"ח בשלח הכ"א)</small></small>

parts.text: לָךְ, שֶׁאַתָּה הוּא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵֽאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד, צוּרֵֽנוּ צוּר חַיֵּֽינוּ וּמָגֵן יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ אַתָּה הוּא, לְדוֹר וָדוֹר נוֹדֶה לְךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ, עַל חַיֵּֽינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶֽךָ, וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵֽינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ, וְעַל נִסֶּֽיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל־יוֹם עִמָּֽנוּ, וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ וְטֽוֹבוֹתֶֽיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל־עֵת, עֶֽרֶב וָבֹֽקֶר וְצָֽהֳרָֽיִם. הַטּוֹב, כִּי לֹא כָלוּ רַחֲמֶֽיךָ, הַמְּרַחֵם, כִּי לֹא תַֽמּוּ חֲסָדֶֽיךָ, כִּי מֵֽעוֹלָם קִוִּֽינוּ לָךְ:

parts.en: In the chazzan's repetition, when the chazzan says Modim, the congregation says:
parts.text: בחזרת הש"ץ כשהחזן אומר מודים, הקהל אומרים:
שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ,
יוֹצְרֵנוּ יוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית. בְּרָכוֹת וְהוֹדָאוֹת לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ,
עַל שֶׁהֶחֱיִיתָנוּ וְקִיַּמְתָּנוּ. כֵּן תְּחַיֵּנוּ וּתְחָנֵּנוּ וְתֶאֱסוֹף גָּלֻיּוֹתֵינוּ לְחַצְרוֹת קָדְשֶׁךָ,
לִשְׁמֹר חֻקֶּיךָ וְלַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ וּלְעָבְדְךָ בְלֵבָב שָׁלֵם,

segs.text: וְעַל כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרַךְ, וְיִתְרוֹמָם, וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא, תָּמִיד, שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ, לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. וְכָל־הַחַיִּים יוֹדֽוּךָ סֶּֽלָה: וִֽיהַֽלְלוּ וִֽיבָֽרְכוּ אֶת־שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל בֶּֽאֱמֶת לְעוֹלָם כִּי טוֹב, הָאֵל יְשֽׁוּעָתֵֽנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵֽנוּ סֶֽלָה, הָאֵל הַטּוֹב: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יֻהֻוֻהֻ, הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת:

segs.en: Priestly Blessing
segs.text: ברכת כהנים

parts.en: When the kohen lifts his feet to raise his hands, say (BA"CH Tetzaveh 12):
parts.text: <small><small>כשעוקר הכהן רגליו לישא כפיו יאמר (בא"ח תצוה י"ב)</small>

לְשֵׁם יִחוּד קֻדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ. בִּדְחִֽילוּ וּרְחִֽימוּ. וּרְחִֽימוּ וּדְחִֽילוּ. לְיַחֲדָא שֵׁם יוֹ"ד קֵ"א בְּוָא"ו קֵ"א בְּיִחוּדָא שְׁלִים. בְּשֵׁם כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מוּכָן וּמְזוּמָן לְקַיֵּם מִצְוַת עֲשֵׂה לְבָרֵךְ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּרְכַּת כֹּהַנִים בִּנְשִׂיאוּת כַּפַּיִם,

לַעֲשׂוֹת נַֽחַת רֽוּחַ לְיֽוֹצְרֵֽנוּ וּלְהַמְשִׁיךְ שֶׁפַע וּבְרָכָה לְכָל־הָעוֹלָמוֹת וְלַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹן בּֽוֹרְאֵֽנוּ. וִיהִ֤י ׀ נֹ֤עַם אֲדֹנָ֥י אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עָ֫לֵ֥ינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָ֭דֵינוּ כּוֹנְנָ֥ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָ֝דֵ֗ינוּ כּוֹנְנֵֽהוּ: </small>

parts.en: When the kohanim stand on the platform after answering 'Modim d'Rabbanan', say:
parts.text: <small><small>וכשעומדים הכהנים על הדוכן לאחר שענו "מודים דרבנן", אומרים</small>

יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ שֶׁתִּהְיֶה בְּרָכָה זוֹ שֶׁצִּּוִיתָֽנוּ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרָכָה שְׁלֵמָה וְלֹא יִהְיֶה בָהּ מִכְשׁוֹל וְעָוֹן מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם:

parts.en: In the chazzan's repetition, say the Priestly Blessing. If there is more than one kohen, the chazzan calls them:
parts.text: <small>בחזרת הש"ץ אומרים ברכת כהנים, אם יש יותר מכהן אחד קורא להם החזן:</small>

segs.en: And the chazzan and the kohanim say word for word:
segs.text: <small>ואומר החזן והכהנים אחריו מילה במילה:</small>

parts.text: <small>יִשָּׂ֨א יְהֹוָ֤ה ׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃</small>

parts.en: When the chazzan begins 'Sim Shalom', the kohanim turn their faces toward the ark; they do not turn before then. Then the kohanim say:
parts.text: <small>וכשמתחיל שליח ציבור "שים שלום" אז מחזירין פניהם כלפי ההיכל, ולא יחזירו פניהם קודם, ואז הכהנים אומרים
רִבּוֹן הָעוֹלָמִים עָשִֽׂינוּ מַה־שֶּׁגָּזַֽרְתָּ עָלֵֽינוּ, עַשֵׂה אַתָּה מַה־שֶּׁהִבְטָחְתָּֽנוּ. הַשְׁקִ֩יפָה֩ מִמְּע֨וֹן קׇדְשְׁךָ֜ מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וּבָרֵ֤ךְ אֶֽת־עַמְּךָ֙ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל:

parts.en: If there are no kohanim, the chazzan says:

parts.text: בָּרְכֵנוּ בַּבְּרָכָה הַמְשֻׁלֶּשֶת בַּתּוֹרָה הַכְּתוּבָה עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּֽךָ,
הָאֲמוּרָה מִפִּי אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו הַכֹּהֲנִים עַם קְדוֹשֶׁיךָ כָּאָמוּר:</small>
<small>יִשָּׂ֨א יְהֹוָ֤ה ׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃</small>
וְשָׂמ֥וּ אֶת־שְׁמִ֖י עַל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַאֲנִ֖י אֲבָרְכֵֽם:</small>

segs.text: שִׂים שָׁלוֹם טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה, חַיִּים חֵן וָחֶֽסֶד וְרַֽחֲמִים, עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ. וּבָֽרְכֵֽנוּ אָבִֽינוּ כֻּלָּֽנוּ כְּאֶחָד בְּאוֹר פָּנֶֽיךָ, כִּי בְאוֹר פָּנֶֽיךָ נָתַֽתָּ לָּֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ תּוֹרָה וְחַיִּים, אַֽהֲבָה וָחֶֽסֶד, צְדָקָה וְרַֽחֲמִים, בְּרָכָה וְשָׁלוֹם. וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ לְבָֽרְכֵֽנוּ וּלְבָרֵךְ אֶת־כָּל־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל, בְּרֹב עֹז וְשָׁלוֹם: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יוּהוּווּהוּ, הַמְּבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשָּׁלוֹם. אָמֵן:
יִֽהְי֥וּ לְרָצ֨וֹן ׀ אִמְרֵי־פִ֡י וְהֶגְי֣וֹן לִבִּ֣י לְפָנֶ֑יךָ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה צוּרִ֥י וְגֹאֲלִֽי׃

parts.text: נְצֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע וְשִׂפְתוֹתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה,
וְאַחֲרֵי מִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ תִּרְדֹּף נַפְשִׁי. וְכָל־הַקָּמִים עָלַי לְרָעָה,
<small>יִֽהְי֗וּ כְּמֹ֥ץ לִפְנֵי־ר֑וּחַ וּמַלְאַ֖ךְ יְהֹוָ֣ה דּוֹחֶֽה. קַבֵּל רִנַּת עַמֶּךָ. שַׂגְּבֵנוּ טַהֲרֵנוּ נוֹרָא.</small>

parts.en: A remedy: say the verse that begins and ends with the same letter as the name you are invoking.
parts.text: <small>סגולה לומר פסוק המתחיל וגומר באות שמתחיל וגומר שמו</small>
לְ֭מַעַן יֵחָלְצ֣וּן יְדִידֶ֑יךָ הוֹשִׁ֖יעָה יְמִֽינְךָ֣ וַעֲנֵֽנִי:

segs.text: יִֽהְי֥וּ לְרָצ֨וֹן ׀ אִמְרֵי־פִ֡י וְהֶגְי֣וֹן לִבִּ֣י לְפָנֶ֑יךָ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה צוּרִ֥י וְגֹאֲלִֽי׃

parts.text: שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו, הוּא בְּרַחֲמָיו יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵֽינוּ, וְעַל כָּל־עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל,

segs.text: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, שֶׁתִּבְנֶה בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בִּמְהֵרָה בְּיָמֵינוּ, וְתֵן חֶלְקֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתָךְ, לַעֲשׂוֹת חֻקֵּי רְצוֹנָךְ וּלְעָבְדָךְ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם:

segs.en: On Yom Tov, after the repetition, say 'Yehi Shem' and then the Chazzan says Kaddish Titkabal. Then continue as on Shabbat.
segs.text: <small>ביום טוב אחרי החזרה אומרים יהי שם, ואחריו אומר הש"ץ קדיש תתקבל. וממשיכים כל ישראל כמו בשבת.</small>

segs.en: On Chol HaMoed, after the repetition, say 'Yehi Shem', then the Chazzan says Kaddish Titkabal, then the Psalm of the day, then Kaddish Shalem, and continue until the end.
segs.text: <small>בחול המועד אחרי החזרה אומרים יהי שם, ואחריו אומר הש"ץ קדיש תתקבל ואומרים המזמור השיך לאותו יום טוב, וקדיש יהא שלמא וקוה עד הסוף.</small>
Hashem, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.

Blessed are You, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob; the great, mighty, and awesome God, God Most High, Who bestows lovingkindness, is the Master of all, and remembers the kindnesses of the fathers, and in love brings a redeemer to their children’s children for the sake of His Name. King, Helper, Savior, and Shield. Blessed are You, Hashem, Shield of Abraham.
You are mighty forever, Hashem; You revive the dead; You are abundant in saving.

parts.text: He causes the dew to fall.
He causes the wind to blow and the rain to fall.

segs.text: He sustains the living with kindness, revives the dead with abundant mercy, supports the fallen, heals the sick, frees the bound, and keeps His faith with those who sleep in the dust. Who is like You, Master of mighty deeds, and who resembles You, King Who brings death and gives life and causes salvation to sprout? And You are faithful to revive the dead. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who revives the dead.

A crown they give You, Hashem our God, the angels, the multitudes on high, together with Your people Israel, gathered below. Together, all of them proclaim holiness to You three times, as is said by Your prophet: “And one called to the other and said: Holy, holy, holy is Hashem of hosts; the whole earth is full of His glory.” His glory fills the world. His attendants ask one another, “Where is the place of His glory?” to exalt Him. Facing them they offer praise and say: “Blessed is the glory of Hashem from His place.” From His place may He turn in mercy to His people, who proclaim the unity of His Name evening and morning, every day, continually, saying twice with love: “Hear, O Israel: Hashem is our God, Hashem is One.” He is our God; He is our Father; He is our King; He is our Savior; He will save us and redeem us a second time, and let us hear, in His mercy, before the eyes of all the living, saying: “Behold, I have redeemed you, the end as at the beginning, to be your God; I am Hashem your God.” And in Your holy words it is written: “Hashem shall reign forever; your God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Halleluyah.”

A crown they give You, Hashem our God, the angels, the multitudes on high, together with Your people Israel, gathered below. Together, all of them proclaim holiness to You three times, as is said by Your prophet: “And one called to the other and said: Holy, holy, holy is Hashem of hosts; the whole earth is full of His glory.” Facing them they offer praise and say: “Blessed is the glory of Hashem from His place.” And in Your holy words it is written: “Hashem shall reign forever; your God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Halleluyah.”
You are holy and Your Name is holy, and holy ones praise You every day, Selah. Blessed are You, Hashem, the holy God.

You have chosen us from among all the peoples; You loved us and desired us; You raised us above all tongues, sanctified us with Your commandments, and brought us near, our King, to Your service, and called us by Your great and holy Name.

parts.text: And You gave us, Hashem our God, with love,
festivals for joy, holidays and seasons for gladness, the day of

segs.text: this Sabbath day, and the day of

parts.text: this Yom Tov, a holy convocation,

segs.text: this Festival of Shavuot, this Yom Tov, a holy convocation, the season of the giving of our Torah

parts.text: this Yom Tov, a holy convocation,

segs.text: this Eighth Day, the Festival of Assembly, this Yom Tov, a holy convocation, the season of our rejoicing.
with love, a holy convocation, in remembrance of the Exodus from Egypt.

Our God and God of our fathers, because of our sins we were exiled from our land and distanced from our soil, and we are unable to ascend, to appear, and to bow before You in Your chosen House, in the great and holy House upon which Your Name is called, because of the hand that was sent against Your Sanctuary.

May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, merciful King, that You return and have mercy on us and on Your Sanctuary in Your abundant mercy, and rebuild it speedily and increase its glory. Our Father, our King, our God, reveal the glory of Your kingship over us speedily; appear and be exalted over us before the eyes of all the living; draw our scattered ones near from among the nations and gather our dispersed from the ends of the earth; and bring us, Hashem our God, to Zion Your city with song, and to Jerusalem, the city of Your Sanctuary, with everlasting joy. Please, our God, and there we will perform before You the offerings of our obligations, the daily offerings in their order and the additional offerings according to their law.
this Festival of Matzot
this Festival of Shavuot
this Festival of Sukkot
this Eighth Day, the Festival of Assembly

parts.text: and the day of this Yom Tov, a holy convocation,
we will perform and offer before You with love, according to the commandment of Your will, as You have written for us in Your Torah, by the hand of Moses Your servant.

segs.text: Our God and God of our fathers, merciful King, have mercy on us; Good and Beneficent One, seek us out; return to us in the abundance of Your mercies, for the sake of the fathers who did Your will. Rebuild Your House as at first and establish Your Sanctuary on its foundation; show us its rebuilding and make us glad in its restoration; restore Your Presence to it, return the kohanim to their service and the Levites to their platform, to their song and music, and return Israel to their dwellings. And there we will ascend, appear, and bow before You three times a year, as it is written in the Torah: “Three times in the year all your males shall appear before Hashem your God in the place that He will choose: on the Festival of Matzot, on the Festival of Shavuot, and on the Festival of Sukkot; and they shall not appear before Hashem empty-handed. Each man with the gift of his hand, according to the blessing of Hashem your God that He has given you.”
Bestow upon us, Hashem our God, the blessing of Your festivals for life, gladness, and peace, as You desired and promised to bless us. So may You bless us, Selah.

parts.text: Our God and God of our fathers,

sanctify us with Your commandments, grant us our share in Your Torah, satisfy us from Your goodness, gladden us with Your salvation, and purify our hearts to serve You in truth; and grant us as our heritage, Hashem our God,
and all Israel, who sanctify Your Name, will rejoice in You.
Blessed are You, Hashem, Who sanctifies

segs.text: Be pleased, Hashem our God, with Your people Israel, and turn to their prayer; restore the service to the inner Sanctuary of Your House, and the fire-offerings of Israel and their prayer, speedily and with love accept with favor, and may the service of Your people Israel always be pleasing to You. And You, in Your abundant mercy, desire us and favor us, and may our eyes behold Your return to Zion in mercy. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who restores His Presence to Zion.

We thank You, for You are Hashem our God and God of our fathers forever and ever; our Rock, the Rock of our lives, Shield of our salvation are You. From generation to generation we will thank You and recount Your praise: for our lives, which are committed into Your hand; for our souls, which are entrusted to You; for Your miracles that are with us every day; and for Your wonders and Your goodnesses at all times, evening, morning, and afternoon. The Good One, for Your mercies never end; the Merciful One, for Your kindnesses never cease; we have always hoped in You.

We give thanks to You, for You are Hashem our God and God of our fathers, God of all flesh, our Creator, Creator of the beginning. Blessings and thanksgivings to Your great and holy Name for having kept us alive and sustained us. So may You keep us alive and be gracious to us, and gather our exiles to the courtyards of Your sanctuary, to keep Your statutes, to do Your will, and to serve You with a whole heart, for we give thanks to You. Blessed is the God of thanksgivings.

And for all these, may Your Name be blessed, exalted, and raised up, always, our King, forever and ever. And all the living will thank You, Selah, and will praise and bless Your great Name in truth, forever, for it is good: the God of our salvation and our help, Selah, the good God. Blessed are You, Hashem, Whose Name is “the Good” and to Whom it is fitting to give thanks.

For the sake of the unification of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah, in fear and love, and love and fear, to unify the Name Yud-Kei with Vav-Kei in perfect unity, in the name of all Israel: behold, I am ready and prepared to fulfill the positive commandment of blessing Israel with the Priestly Blessing by raising the hands, to bring contentment to our Maker, to draw down abundance and blessing to all the worlds, and to do the will of our Creator. “May the pleasantness of Hashem our God be upon us; establish the work of our hands upon us, and the work of our hands, establish it.”

May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that this blessing which You commanded us to give Your people Israel be a complete blessing, with no stumbling block or sin in it, from now and forever.
Kohanim! Blessed are You, Hashem our God, King of the universe, Who has sanctified us with the holiness of Aaron and commanded us to bless His people Israel with love. Amen.
May Hashem bless you and protect you. Amen.
May Hashem make His face shine upon you and be gracious to you. Amen.
May Hashem lift up His face to you and grant you peace. Amen.
Master of the worlds, we have done what You decreed upon us; do what You promised us. Look down from Your holy dwelling, from heaven, and bless Your people, Israel.
Our God and God of our fathers, bless us with the threefold blessing written in the Torah by the hand of Moses Your servant, spoken by Aaron and his sons the kohanim, Your holy people, as it is said:
May Hashem bless you and protect you. So may it be His will.
May Hashem make His face shine upon you and be gracious to you. So may it be His will.
May Hashem lift up His face to you and grant you peace. So may it be His will. “They shall place My Name upon the children of Israel, and I will bless them.”

Grant peace, goodness, and blessing, life, grace, kindness, and mercy upon us and upon all Israel, Your people. Bless us, our Father, all of us as one, with the light of Your face, for by the light of Your face You gave us, Hashem our God, a Torah of life, love and kindness, righteousness, mercy, blessing, and peace. And may it be good in Your eyes to bless us and to bless all Your people Israel with abundant strength and peace. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who blesses His people Israel with peace. Amen.
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before You, Hashem, my Rock and my Redeemer.

My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking deceit. To those who curse me, let my soul be silent, and let my soul be like dust to all. Open my heart to Your Torah, and let my soul pursue Your commandments. As for all who plan evil against me, quickly nullify their counsel and disrupt their plans. Let them be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of Hashem driving them on. Accept the prayer of Your people; raise us up, purify us, Awesome One. Act for the sake of Your Name; act for the sake of Your right hand; act for the sake of Your Torah; act for the sake of Your holiness.
So that Your beloved ones may be rescued, save with Your right hand and answer me.
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before You, Hashem, my Rock and my Redeemer.
He Who makes peace in His heights, may He in His mercy make peace for us and for all His people Israel, and say: Amen.

May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that the Holy Temple be rebuilt speedily in our days, and grant us our portion in Your Torah, to do the statutes of Your will and to serve You with a whole heart.

segs.text: פָּתַח אֵלִיָּֽהוּ הַנָּבִיא זָכוּר לְטוֹב וְאָמַר: רִבּוֹן עָֽלְמִֽין דְּאַנְתְּ הוּא חָד וְלָא בְּחֻשְׁבָּן. אַנְתְּ הוּא עִלָּאָה עַל-כָּל-עִלָּאִין סְתִימָא עַל-כָּל-סְתִימִין. לֵית מַחֲשָׁבָה תְּפִיסָא בָךְ כְּלָל: אַנְתְּ הוּא דְאַפַּקְתְּ עֶֽשֶׂר תִּקּוּנִין וְקָרֵינָן לוֹן עֶֽשֶׂר סְפִירָן. לְאַנְהָגָא בְהוֹן עָֽלְמִֽין סְתִימִין דְּלָא אִתְגַּלְיָן וְעָֽלְמִֽין דְּאִתְגַּלְיָן. וּבְהוֹן אִתְכַּסִּיאַת מִבְּנֵי נָשָׁא. וְאַנְתְּ הוּא דְּקָשִׁיר לוֹן וּמְיַחֵד לוֹן: וּבְגִין דְּאַנְתְּ מִלְּגָאו. כָּל-מָאן דְּאַפְרִישׁ חַד מִן חַבְרֵיהּ מֵאִלֵּין עֶֽשֶׂר אִתְחַשִּׁיב לֵיהּ כְּאִלּוּ אַפְרִישׁ בָּֽךְ: וְאִלֵּין עֶֽשֶׂר סְפִירָן אִנּוּן אָֽזְלִֽין כְּסִדְרָן. חַד אָרִיךְ וְחַד קָצֵר וְחַד בֵּינוֹנִי: וְאַנְתְּ הוּא דְּאַנְהִיג לוֹן. וְלֵית מָאן דְּאַנְהִיג לָךְ. לָא לְעֵֽלָּא וְלָא לְתַֽתָּא וְלָא מִכָּל-סִטְרָא. לְבוּשִׁין תַּקַּנְתְּ לוֹן דְּמִנַּֽיְהוּ פָֽרְחִֽין נִשְׁמָתִין לִבְנֵי נָשָׁא: וְכַמָּה גוּפִין תַּקַּנְתְּ לוֹן דְּאִתְקְרִֽיאוּ גוּפָא לְגַבֵּי לְבוּשִׁין דִּמְכַסְיָן עֲלֵיהוֹן: וְאִתְקְרִֽיאוּ בְּתִקּוּנָא דָא. חֶֽסֶד דְּרוֹעָא יְמִינָא. גְּבוּרָה דְּרוֹעָא שְׂמָאלָא. תִּפְאֶֽרֶת גּוּפָא. נֶֽצַח וְהוֹד תְּרֵין שׁוֹקִין. יְסוֹד סִיּוּמָא דְגוּפָא אוֹת בְּרִית קֽוֹדֶשׁ. מַלְכוּת פֶּה תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל-פֶּה קָרֵֽינָן לָהּ. חָכְמָה מוֹחָא אִֽיהִי מַחֲשָׁבָה מִלְּגָאו. בִּינָה לִבָּא וּבָהּ הַלֵּב מֵבִין. וְעַל אִלֵּין תְּרֵין כְּתִיב הַנִּ֨סְתָּרֹ֔ת לַיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ. כֶּֽתֶר עֶלְיוֹן אִֽיהוּ כֶּֽתֶר מַלְכוּת. וְעָלֵיהּ אִתְמַר מַגִּיד מֵרֵאשִׁית אַחֲרִית. וְאִֽיהוּ קַרְקַפְתָּא דִתְפִלֵּי: מִלְּגָאו אִֽיהוּ אוֹת יוֹ"ד וְאוֹת הֵ"א וְאוֹת וָא"ו וְאוֹת הֵ"א דְּאִֽיהוּ אֹֽרַח אֲצִילוּת. אִֽיהוּ שַׁקְיוּ דְאִילָנָא בִּדְרוֹעוֹי וְעַנְפּוֹי. כְּמַיָּא דְאַשְׁקֵי לְאִילָנָא וְאִתְרַבֵּי בְּהַהוּא שַׁקְיוּ:

רִבּוֹן עָֽלְמִֽין אַנְתְּ הוּא עִלַּת הָעִלּוֹת וְסִבַּת הַסִּבּוֹת דְּאַשְׁקֵי לְאִילָנָא בְּהַהוּא נְבִיעוּ. וְהַהוּא נְבִיעוּ אִֽיהוּ כְּנִשְׁמְתָא לְגוּפָא דְּאִֽיהִי חַיִּים לְגוּפָא: וּבָךְ לֵית דִּמְיוֹן וְלֵית דִּיּוּקְנָא (דְּגוּפָא) מִכָּל-מַה-דִּלְגַאו וּלְבַר. וּבָרָֽאתָ שְׁמַיָּא וְאַרְעָא. וְאַפַּקְתְּ מִנְּהוֹן שִׁמְשָׁא וְסִיהֲרָא וְכוֹכְבַיָּא וּמַזָּלֵי. וּבְאַרְעָא אִילָנִין וּדְשָׁאִין וְגִנְּתָא דְעֵֽדֶן וְעִשְׂבִּין וְחֵיוָן וְעוֹפִין וְנוּנִין וּבְעִירִין וּבְנֵי נָשָׁא. לְאִשְׁתְּמֽוֹדְעָֽא בְהוֹן עִלָּאִין וְאֵיךְ יִתְנַהֲגוּן בְּהוֹן עִלָּאִין וְתַתָּאִין. וְאֵיךְ אִשְׁתְּמֽוֹדְעָֽן מֵעִלָּאֵי וְתַתָּאֵי וְלֵית דְּיָדַע בָּךְ כְּלָל. וּבַר מִנָּךְ לֵית יִחוּדָא בְּעִלָּאֵי וְתַתָּאֵי. וְאַנְתְּ אִשְׁתְּמוֹדָע אָדוֹן עַל-כֹּֽלָּא: וְכָל-סְפִירָן כָּל-חַד אִית לֵיהּ שֵׁם יְדִֽיעַ. וּבְהוֹן אִתְקְרִֽיאוּ מַלְאָכַיָּא. וְאַנְתְּ לֵית לָךְ שֵׁם יְדִֽיעַ. דְּאַנְתְּ הוּא מְמַלֵּא כָּל-שְׁמָהָן וְאַנְתְּ הוּא שְׁלִֽימוּ דְּכֻלְּהוּ: וְכַד אַנְתְּ תִּסְתַּלָּק מִנְּהוֹן. אִשְׁתְּאָֽרוּ כֻּלְּהוּ שְׁמָהָן כְּגוּפָא בְלָא נִשְׁמָתָא: אַנְתְּ הוּא חַכִּים וְלָאו בְּחָכְמָה יְדִיעָא. אַנְתְּ הוּא מֵבִין וְלָאו מִבִּינָה יְדִיעָא. לֵית לָךְ אֲתָר יְדִיעָא. אֶלָּא לְאִשְׁתְּמֽוֹדְעָא תֻּקְפָךְ וְחֵילָךְ לִבְנֵי נָשָׁא. וּלְאַחְזָאָה לוֹן אֵיךְ אִתְנְהִיג עָֽלְמָא בְּדִינָא וּבְרַחֲמֵי דְּאִנּוּן צֶֽדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט כְּפוּם עוֹבָדֵיהוֹן דִּבְנֵי נָשָׁא: דִּין אִֽיהוּ גְבוּרָה. מִשְׁפָּט עַמּוּדָא דְאֶמְצָעִיתָא. צֶֽדֶק מַלְכוּתָא קַדִּישָׁא. מֹֽאזְנֵֽי צֶֽדֶק תְּרֵין סַמְכֵי קְשׁוֹט. הִין צֶֽדֶק אוֹת בְּרִית. כֹּלָּא לְאַחְזָאָה אֵיךְ אִתְנְהִיג עָֽלְמָא: אֲבָל לָאו דְּאִית לָךְ צֶֽדֶק יְדִיעָא דְּאִֽיהוּ דִין. וְלָאו מִשְׁפָּט יְדִיעָא דְאִֽיהוּ רַחֲמֵי. וְלָאו מִכָּל-אִלֵּין מִדּוֹת כְּלָל:

parts.text: וַיִּזְרַ֤ע יִצְחָק֙ בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַהִ֔וא וַיִּמְצָ֛א בַּשָּׁנָ֥ה הַהִ֖וא מֵאָ֣ה שְׁעָרִ֑ים וַֽיְבָרֲכֵ֖הוּ יְהֹוָֽה׃
וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֥ם כֹּ֖ה לֶחָ֑י וְאַתָּ֤ה שָׁלוֹם֙ וּבֵיתְךָ֣ שָׁל֔וֹם וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃

segs.text: תָּחֵל שָׁנָה וּבִרְכוֹתֶֽיהָ:
אָֽנָּֽא יְהֹוָֽה הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי אוֹרָה, בִּזְכוּת הַצַּדִּיק הַסּוֹפֵר עֶזְרָא.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי אַהֲבָה, בִּזְכוּת אַבַּיֵּֽי וְרָבָא.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי בְרָכָה, בִּזְכוּת אֶסְתֵּר הַמַּלְכָּה.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי בִינָה, בִּזְכוּת רִבִּי נְחוּנְיָא בֶּן-הַקָּנָה.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי גְדֻלָּה, בִּזְכוּת הָאֲמוֹרָא עוּלָֽא.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי דַּֽעַת הַבָּהִיר, בִּזְכוּת מָרְדְּכַי בֶּן-יָאִיר.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי הַצְלָחָה, בִּזְכוּת רִבִּי יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ בֶּן-קָרְחָה.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי וַֽעַד טוֹב, בִּזְכוּת מֹשֶׁה הַנִּקְרָא טוֹב.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי זִמְרָה, בִּזְכוּת רִבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן-בְּתֵירָא.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי חֲנִינָה, בִּזְכוּת הַנְּבִיאָה חַנָּה.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי חָכְמָה, בִּזְכוּת רִבִּי יְהוּדָה בֶּן-תֵּימָֽא.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי טָהֳרָה, בִּזְכוּת הַנְּבִיאָה דְבוֹרָה.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי טוֹבָה, בִּזְכוּת רִבִּי עֲקִיבָֽא.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי יֶֽשַׁע, בִּזְכוּת הַנָּבִיא אֱלִישָׁע.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי יֹֽשֶׁר, בִּזְכוּת הַצַּדִיק אָשֵׁר.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי כַלְכָּלָה, בִּזְכוּת מִיכָֽיְהוּ בֶּן-יִמְלָא.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי לְוָיָה, בִּזְכוּת נְחֶמְיָה בֶּן-חֲכַלְיָה.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי מַדָּע, בִּזְכוּת בְּנָיָהוּ בֶּן-יְהוֹיָדָע.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי נְדָבָה, בִּזְכוּת רִבִּי יְהוּדָה בֶּן-בָּבָא.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי סְמִיכָה, בִּזְכוּת הַנָּבִיא מִיכָה.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי עֲלִיָּה, בִּזְכוּת רִבִּי יְהוֹשֻֽׁע בֶּן-פְּרַחְיָה.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי עֶזְרָה, בִּזְכוּת רִבִּי יְהוּדָה בֶּן-בְּתֵירָה.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי פַרְנָסָה, בִּזְכוּת רִבִּי חֲנִינָא בֶּן-דּוֹסָא.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי פְדִיָּה, בִּזְכוּת רִבִּי יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ בֶּן-חֲנַנְיָה.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי פִרְיָה וְרִבְיָה,	בִּזְכוּת חֲנַנְיָה מִישָׁאֵל וַעֲזַרְיָה.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי צְדָקָה, בִּזְכוּת שָֹרָה וְרִבְקָה.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי צַדִּיק חַי, בִּזְכוּת רִבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן-יוֹחַֽאי.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי קֵץ הַיָּמִין, בִּזְכוּת הַצַּדִּיק בִּנְיָמִין.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי קַבָּלַת תַּחֲנוּן, בִּזְכוּת יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ בִּן-נוּן.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי רוֹמְמוֹת אֵל, בִּזְכוּת דָּוִד מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְֹרָאֵל.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי שֹֽוֹבַע, בִּזְכוּת הַצַּדֶּֽקֶת אֱלִישֶֽׁבַע.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי תְעוּדָה, בִּזְכוּת חִזְקִיָּֽהוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה.
תִּפְתַּח לָֽנוּ שַׁעֲרֵי תְבוּנָה, בִּזְכוּת הַנָּבִיא יוֹנָה.

תּֽוֹדִיעֵנִי֮ אֹ֤רַח חַ֫יִּ֥ים שֹׂ֣בַע שְׂ֭מָחוֹת אֶת־פָּנֶ֑יךָ נְעִמ֖וֹת בִּימִינְךָ֣ נֶֽצַח׃ אָנָּ֣א יְ֭הֹוָה הוֹשִׁ֘יעָ֥ה נָּ֑א אָֽנָּ֥א יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה הַצְלִ֘יחָ֥ה נָֽא׃ יִשָּׂ֣א בְ֭רָכָה מֵאֵ֣ת יְהֹוָ֑ה וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה מֵאֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעֽוֹ׃ וְֽהָיָ֗ה כְּעֵץ֮ שָׁת֪וּל עַֽל־פַּלְגֵ֫י מָ֥יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר פִּרְי֨וֹ׀ יִתֵּ֬ן בְּעִתּ֗וֹ וְעָלֵ֥הוּ לֹֽא־יִבּ֑וֹל וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יַצְלִֽיחַ׃
אָֽנָּֽא יְהֹוָֽה הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת אוֹרָה,	וְנִהְיֶה חֲכָמִים וּנְבוֹנִים בַּתּוֹרָה.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת בְּרָכָה,	וְהָיְתָ֥ה לַֽיהֹוָ֖ה הַמְּלוּכָֽה.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת גִּילָה,	סֹ֣לּוּ סֹ֤לּוּ הַֽמְסִלָּה֙.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת דִּיצָה,	יְהֹוָֽה מָשְׁכֵ֖נִי אַחֲרֶ֣יךָ נָּר֑וּצָה.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת הַצְלָחָה,	וְנָ֖סוּ יָג֥וֹן וַאֲנָחָֽה.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת וַֽעַד טוֹב,	כִּי יְ֭הֹוָה יִתֵּ֣ן הַטּ֑וֹב.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת זִמְרָה,	וְ֭לַיְלָה כַּיּ֣וֹם יָאִ֑יר כַּ֝חֲשֵׁיכָ֗ה כָּאוֹרָֽה.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת חֲנִינָה,	וּפְדוּיֵ֨י יְהֹוָ֜ה יְשׁוּב֗וּן וּבָ֤אוּ צִיּוֹן֙ בְּרִנָּ֔ה.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת טוֹבָה,	אִמְרוּ֙ לְבַת־צִיּ֔וֹן הִנֵּ֥ה יִשְׁעֵ֖ךְ בָּ֑א.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת יֹֽשֶׁר,	מַה־נָּאו֨וּ עַל־הֶהָרִ֜ים רַגְלֵ֣י מְבַשֵּׂ֗ר.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת כַּלְכָּלה,	אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה יַצְמִ֤יחַ צְדָקָה֙ וּתְהִלָּ֔ה.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת לְוָיָה,	דִּשַּׁ֖נְתָּ בַשֶּׁ֥מֶן רֹ֝אשִׁ֗י כּוֹסִ֥י רְוָיָֽה.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת מַעֲלָה.	תְּשֻׁא֕וֹת חֵ֥ן חֵ֖ן לָֽהּ.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת נְדָבָה,	וְעַ֥ל כָּל־פְּ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תְּכַסֶּ֥ה אַהֲבָֽה.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת סְמִיכָה,	צִוָּ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה אֶת־הַבְּרָכָ֑ה.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת עֶזְרָה,	שָׂשׂ֤וֹן וְשִׂמְחָה֙ יִמָּ֣צֵא בָ֔הּ תּוֹדָ֖ה וְק֥וֹל זִמְרָֽה.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת פַּרְנָסָה טוֹבָה,	וּמָלְא֥וּ פְנֵי־תֵבֵ֖ל תְּנוּבָֽה.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת צָהֳלָה,	חֵן וָחֶֽסֶד וְרַחֲמִים, רֶֽוַח וְהַצָּלָה.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת קִרוּן פָּנִים,	עֲטֶֽרֶת זְקֵנִים וְתִפְאֶֽרֶת בָּנִים.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת רַחֲמִים,	יְהֹוָ֑ה לֹ֥א יִמְנַע־ט֝֗וֹב לַֽהֹלְכִ֥ים בְּתָמִֽים.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת רָצוֹן,	וְהִנֵּה֙ רָחֵ֣ל בָּאָ֖ה עִם־הַצֹּֽאן.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת שָׁלוֹם,	יְהֹוָ֓ה ׀ יְבָרֵ֖ךְ אֶת־עַמּ֣וֹ בַשָּׁלֽוֹם.
שָֽׁנָה זוֹ תִּהְיֶה שְׁנַת תְּשׁוּעָה, וְהָיָ֤ה הֶֽעָקֹב֙ לְמִישׁ֔וֹר וְהָרְכָסִ֖ים לְבִקְעָֽה.

וּמִטּוּב בֵּית יְהֹוָֽה נִשְׂבְּעָה, וְכַכָּתוּב וּשְׁאַבְתֶּם־מַ֖יִם בְּשָׂשׂ֑וֹן מִמַּעַיְנֵ֖י הַיְשׁוּעָֽה׃ לִֽישׁוּעָתְךָ֖ קִוִּ֥יתִי יְהֹוָֽה׃ לִֽישׁוּעָתְךָ֖ קִוִּ֥יתִי יְהֹוָֽה׃ לְפֻרְקָנָךְ סַבָּרִית יְהֹוָֽה. אָנָּ֣א יְ֭הֹוָה הוֹשִׁ֘יעָ֥ה נָּ֑א, אָנָּ֣א יְ֭הֹוָה הוֹשִׁ֘יעָ֥ה נָּ֑א, אָֽנָּ֥א יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה הַצְלִ֘יחָ֥ה נָֽא׃ אָֽנָּ֥א יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה הַצְלִ֘יחָ֥ה נָֽא׃

segs.en: On Shabbat, say the entire Kiddush order until the end of 'the sixth day', except for 'Azmar Bishvachin', and then say:
segs.text: <small>בשבת אומר כל סדר הקידוש עד סוף "יום הששי" חוץ מ"אזמר בשבחין" ואחר כך אומר</small>

וּבְי֨וֹם שִׂמְחַתְכֶ֥ם וּֽבְמוֹעֲדֵיכֶם֮ וּבְרָאשֵׁ֣י חָדְשֵׁיכֶם֒ וּתְקַעְתֶּ֣ם בַּחֲצֹֽצְרֹ֗ת עַ֚ל עֹלֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעַ֖ל זִבְחֵ֣י שַׁלְמֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָי֨וּ לָכֶ֤ם לְזִכָּרוֹן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

parts.en: And the one saying Kiddush says:

segs.text: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, בּוֹרֵא פְּרִי הַגֶּֽפֶן:

parts.text: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה, אֱלהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר בָּֽנוּ מִכָּל-עָם וְרוֹמְמָֽנוּ מִכָּל-לָשׁוֹן וְקִדְּשָֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו, וַתִּֽתֶּן לָֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה, אֶת יוֹם

הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה אֶת יוֹם טוֹב מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ הַזֶּה, יוֹם תְּרוּעָה (זִכְרוֹן תְּרוּעָה בְּאַהֲבָה( מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ זֵֽכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָֽיִם. וּדְבָרְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ אֱמֶת וְקַיָּם לָעַד: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה, מֶלֶךְ עַל-כָּל-הָאָרֶץ מְקַדֵּשׁ

segs.en: On Motzaei Shabbat, add:
segs.text: <small>במוצאי שבת מוסיפים</small>
<small>בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, בּוֹרֵא מְאוֹרֵי הָאֵשׁ: </small>

<small>בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, הַמַּבְדִּיל בֵּין קֹֽדֶשׁ לְחֹל, וּבֵין אוֹר לְחֹֽשֶׁךְ, וּבֵין יִשְׂרָאֵל לָעַמִּים, וּבֵין יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי לְשֵֽׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה, בֵּין קְדֻשַּׁת שַׁבָּת לִקְדֻשַּׁת יוֹם טוֹב הִבְדַּֽלְתָּ, וְאֶת יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִשֵּֽׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הִקְדַּֽשְׁתָּ וְהִבְדַּֽלְתָּ, וְהִקְדַּֽשְׁתָּ אֶת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּקְדֻשָּׁתָךְ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה, הַמַּבְדִּיל בֵּין קֹֽדֶשׁ לְקֹֽדֶשׁ: </small>

segs.en: Also on the second night, bless Shehecheyanu and bring a new fruit to the table to intend for it during the blessing.

segs.text: Eliyahu the prophet, may he be remembered for good, began and said: Master of the worlds, You are One, but not in number. You are the highest of all the high, the most hidden of all the hidden; no thought can grasp You at all. You are He who brought forth ten perfections, which we call the ten sefirot, to guide through them hidden worlds that are not revealed and worlds that are revealed; and through them You are concealed from human beings. And You are He who binds them together and unites them; and because You are within them, whoever separates one of these ten from another is considered as if he had made a separation in You. And these ten sefirot proceed in their order: one long, one short, and one intermediate. And You are He who guides them, and there is none who guides You: not above, not below, and not from any side. You made garments for them, from which souls fly to human beings; and You made many bodies for them, which are called “body” in relation to the garments that cover them; and they are called by this arrangement: Chesed is the right arm; Gevurah is the left arm; Tiferet is the torso; Netzach and Hod are the two thighs; Yesod is the end of the body, the sign of the holy covenant; Malchut is the mouth, which we call the Oral Torah. Chochmah is the brain, the thought within; Binah is the heart, with which the heart understands. Of these two it is written: “The hidden things belong to Hashem our God.” Keter Elyon is the crown of royalty, of which it is said: “Declaring the end from the beginning”; and it is the skull of the tefillin. Within it are the letter Yud, the letter Heh, the letter Vav, the letter Heh, which is the path of emanation. It is the watering of the tree, with its arms and its branches, like water that waters a tree, which grows through that watering.

Master of the worlds, You are the Cause of causes and the Reason of reasons, who waters the tree from that spring; and that spring is like the soul to the body, which is life to the body. But in You there is no likeness and no image (of a body) of anything, within or without. You created heaven and earth, and brought forth from them the sun and the moon, the stars and the constellations; and on the earth, trees, grasses, the Garden of Eden, plants, beasts, birds, fish, animals and human beings; to make known through them the upper beings, and how the upper and lower beings are to be guided through them, and how the upper and lower beings are to be known; yet there is none who knows You at all. Apart from You there is no unity among the upper and lower beings, and You are known as Master over all. Each of the sefirot has a known name, and by them the angels are called; but You have no known name, for You fill all the names, and You are the completeness of them all. And when You withdraw from them, all the names remain like a body without a soul. You are wise, but not with a known wisdom; You are understanding, but not with a known understanding. You have no known place, but to make known to human beings Your strength and Your power, and to show them how the world is guided with justice and with mercy, which are tzedek and mishpat, according to the deeds of human beings. Din is gevurah; mishpat is the middle pillar; tzedek is the holy kingdom; the scales of justice are the two supports of truth; the just hin is the sign of the covenant. All this is to show how the world is guided. But it is not that You have a known justice, which is din, nor a known judgment, which is mercy, nor any of these attributes at all.
And Noah found favor in the eyes of Hashem.
And Isaac sowed in that land, and in that year he found a hundredfold, and Hashem blessed him.
For with You is the source of life; by Your light we see light.
Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
And you shall say to the living one: Peace to you, peace to your house, and peace to all that is yours.
May the year and its blessings begin.
Please, Hashem, great, mighty, and awesome God.
Open for us the gates of light, in the merit of the righteous scribe Ezra.
Open for us the gates of love, in the merit of Abaye and Rava.
Open for us the gates of blessing, in the merit of Esther the Queen.
Open for us the gates of understanding, in the merit of Rabbi Nechunya ben HaKaneh.
Open for us the gates of greatness, in the merit of the Amora Ulla.
Open for us the gates of bright knowledge, in the merit of Mordechai ben Yair.
Open for us the gates of success, in the merit of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Korcha.
Open for us the gates of good fellowship, in the merit of Moses, who is called “good”.
Open for us the gates of song, in the merit of Rabbi Shimon ben Beteira.
Open for us the gates of grace, in the merit of the prophetess Hannah.
Open for us the gates of wisdom, in the merit of Rabbi Yehudah ben Teima.
Open for us the gates of purity, in the merit of the prophetess Deborah.
Open for us the gates of goodness, in the merit of Rabbi Akiva.
Open for us the gates of salvation, in the merit of the prophet Elisha.
Open for us the gates of uprightness, in the merit of the righteous Asher.
Open for us the gates of sustenance, in the merit of Micaiah ben Imlah.
Open for us the gates of companionship, in the merit of Nehemiah ben Hachaliah.
Open for us the gates of knowledge, in the merit of Benaiah ben Yehoyada.
Open for us the gates of generosity, in the merit of Rabbi Yehudah ben Bava.
Open for us the gates of support, in the merit of the prophet Micah.
Open for us the gates of ascent, in the merit of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Perachyah.
Open for us the gates of help, in the merit of Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira.
Open for us the gates of livelihood, in the merit of Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa.
Open for us the gates of redemption, in the merit of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Chananyah.
Open for us the gates of fruitfulness and increase, in the merit of Chananyah, Mishael, and Azaryah.
Open for us the gates of charity, in the merit of Sarah and Rebecca.
Open for us the gates of the living righteous one, in the merit of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai.
Open for us the gates of the end of days, in the merit of the righteous Benjamin.
Open for us the gates of acceptance of supplication, in the merit of Joshua son of Nun.
Open for us the gates of the exaltation of God, in the merit of David, king of Israel.
Open for us the gates of abundance, in the merit of the righteous Elisheva.
Open for us the gates of testimony, in the merit of Hezekiah, king of Judah.
Open for us the gates of discernment, in the merit of the prophet Jonah.

You make known to me the path of life; in Your presence is fullness of joy, in Your right hand eternal delights. Please, Hashem, save us; please, Hashem, grant us success. He will receive a blessing from Hashem and righteousness from the God of his salvation. He shall be like a tree planted by streams of water, that yields its fruit in its season, whose leaf does not wither; and in all that he does he will succeed.
Please, Hashem, great, mighty, and awesome God.
This year will be a year of light; and we will be wise and understanding in Torah.
This year will be a year of blessing; “and the kingdom shall be Hashem’s.”
This year will be a year of rejoicing; “Build up, build up the highway.”
This year will be a year of delight; “Draw me after You, Hashem, let us run.”
This year will be a year of success; “and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.”
This year will be a year of good fellowship; “for Hashem will give what is good.”
This year will be a year of song; “and the night shall shine like the day; darkness is as light.”
This year will be a year of grace; “and the redeemed of Hashem shall return and come to Zion with singing.”
This year will be a year of goodness; “Say to the daughter of Zion: Behold, your salvation has come.”
This year will be a year of uprightness; “How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of the herald.”
This year will be a year of sustenance; “the Lord Hashem will cause righteousness and praise to sprout.”
This year will be a year of companionship; “You have anointed my head with oil; my cup overflows.”
This year will be a year of elevation; “shouts of ‘Grace, grace to it!’”
This year will be a year of generosity; “and love covers all transgressions.”
This year will be a year of support; “Hashem commanded the blessing.”
This year will be a year of help; “joy and gladness will be found in it, thanksgiving and the sound of song.”
This year will be a year of good livelihood; “and they shall fill the face of the world with produce.”
This year will be a year of jubilation; grace, kindness, and mercy, relief and deliverance.
This year will be a year of radiance of face; a crown for the elders and the glory of children.
This year will be a year of mercy; “Hashem will not withhold good from those who walk uprightly.”
This year will be a year of favor; “and behold, Rachel is coming with the flock.”
This year will be a year of peace; “Hashem will bless His people with peace.”
This year will be a year of salvation; “the uneven ground shall become level and the rugged places a plain.”

“And may we be satisfied with the goodness of the House of Hashem,” and as it is written: “You shall draw water with joy from the springs of salvation.” “I have hoped for Your salvation, Hashem; I have hoped for Your salvation, Hashem; for Your deliverance I have hoped, Hashem.” Please, Hashem, save us; please, Hashem, save us; please, Hashem, grant us success; please, Hashem, grant us success.

“And on the day of your gladness, and on your festivals, and on your new moons, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and over your peace offerings; and they shall be a remembrance for you before your God. I am Hashem your God.”
With your permission, my masters. To life!
Blessed are You, Hashem our God, King of the universe, Who creates the fruit of the vine.

parts.text: Blessed are You, Hashem our God, King of the universe, Who has chosen us from every people, exalted us above every tongue, and sanctified us with His commandments. And You gave us, Hashem our God, with love, the day of
this Sabbath day and the day of

this Day of Remembrance, the day of this Yom Tov, a holy convocation, a day of sounding the shofar (a remembrance of the sounding, with love), a holy convocation in remembrance of the Exodus from Egypt. Your word, our King, is true and endures forever. Blessed are You, Hashem, King over all the earth, Who sanctifies
Israel and the Day of Remembrance.

segs.text: Blessed are You, Hashem our God, King of the universe, Who creates the lights of the fire.

Blessed are You, Hashem our God, King of the universe, Who distinguishes between holy and profane, between light and darkness, between Israel and the nations, between the seventh day and the six days of work. You have distinguished between the holiness of Shabbat and the holiness of Yom Tov, and You sanctified the seventh day above the six days of work; You distinguished and sanctified Your people Israel with Your holiness. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who distinguishes between holy and holy.
Blessed are You, Hashem our God, King of the universe, Who has kept us alive, sustained us, and brought us to this season.
Blessed are You, Hashem our God, King of the universe, Who creates the fruit of the tree.
Blessed are You, Hashem our God, King of the universe, Who creates the fruit of the ground.
May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that our enemies, those who hate us, and all who seek our harm come to an end.
May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that our merits increase and our hearts be strengthened.
May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that our enemies, those who hate us, and all who seek our harm be cut off.
May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that our enemies, those who hate us, and all who seek our harm be removed.
May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that You tear up the evil of our decree, and that our merits be proclaimed before You.
May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that we be as full of mitzvot as a pomegranate is full of seeds.
May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that a good and sweet year (like honey) be renewed for us.

May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that we be as the head and not the tail, and that You remember for us (the binding and) the ram of Isaac our father, son of Abraham our father, peace be upon them.
May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that a good and sweet year be renewed for us, from the beginning of the year until the end of the year.

May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that Your enemies, those who hate You, and all who seek our harm be cut off. And then say: “Let Your hand be lifted up against Your adversaries, and may all Your enemies be cut off.”

May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that Your enemies, those who hate You, and all who seek our harm be removed. And then say: “Depart from me, all you evildoers, for Hashem has heard the sound of my weeping. Depart, depart, go out from there, touch nothing unclean; go out from its midst, purify yourselves, you who carry the vessels of Hashem.”

May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that Your enemies, those who hate You, and all who seek our harm come to an end. And then say: “Let sinners cease from the earth, and the wicked be no more. Bless Hashem, my soul. Halleluyah.”
May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that You tear up the evil of our decree, and that our merits be proclaimed before You.
May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that our merits increase.

May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that we be as the head and not the tail. (If it is a sheep’s head, add: and that You remember for us the ram of Isaac our father, peace be upon him.)

segs.text: לְשֵׁם יִחוּד קֻדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ, בִּדְחִֽילוּ וּרְחִֽימוּ, וּרְחִֽימוּ וּדְחִֽילוּ, לְיַחֲדָא שֵׁם יוֹ"ד קֵ"א בְּוָא"ו קֵ"א בְּיִחוּדָא שְׁלִים, בְּשֵׁם כָּל-יִשְׂרָאֵל. וּבְשֵׁם כָּל־הַנְּפָשׁוֹת. וְהָרוּחוֹת וְהַנְּשָׁמוֹת הַמִּתְיַחֲסִים אֶל שָׁרְשֵׁי נַפְשֵֽׁנוּ רוּחֵֽנוּ וְנִשְׁמָתֵֽנוּ וּמַלְבּוּשֵׁיהֶם וְהַקְּרוֹבִים לָהֶם. שֶׁמִּכְּלָלוּת אֲצִילוּת בְּרִיאָה יְצִירָה עֲשִׂיָּה. וּמִכָּל־פִּרְטֵי אֲצִילוּת בְּרִיאָה יְצִירָה עֲשִׂיָּה. דְּכָל-פַּרְצוּף וּסְפִירָה דְּפִרְטֵי אֲצִילוּת בְּרִיאָה יְצִירָה עֲשִׂיָּה. הִנֵּה אֲנַֽחְנוּ בָּאִים לְקַיֵּם מִצְוַת עֲשֵׂה לִישֵׁב בַּסֻּכָּה. כְּמוֹ שֶׁצִּוָּֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּתוֹרָתוֹ הַקְּדוֹשָׁה עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּֽינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם. בַּסֻּכֹּ֥ת תֵּשְׁב֖וּ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים כָּל־הָֽאֶזְרָח֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יֵשְׁב֖וּ בַּסֻּכֹּֽת׃ לְמַעַן֮ יֵדְע֣וּ דֹרֹֽתֵיכֶם֒ כִּ֣י בַסֻּכּ֗וֹת הוֹשַׁ֙בְתִּי֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּהוֹצִיאִ֥י אוֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם: לְתַקֵּן שֽׁוֹרֶשׁ מִצְוָה זוֹ בְּמָקוֹם עֶלְיוֹן, לַעֲשׂוֹת כַּוָּנַת יוֹצְרֵֽנוּ שֶׁצִּוָּֽנוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת מִצְוָה זוֹ, לְהַשְׁלִים אִילָן הָעֶלְיוֹן וּלְהָקִים סֻכַּת דָּוִד לְהַחֲזִיר הָעֲטָרָה לְיָשְׁנָהּ. וּלְהַשְׁלִים שְׁלֵימוּת תִקוּן הַנְּפָשׁוֹת וְהָרוּחוֹת וְהַנְּשָׁמוֹת שֶׁמִּכְּלָלוּת אֲצִילוּת בְּרִיאָה יְצִירָה עֲשִׂיָּה. וּמִכָּל־פִּרְטֵי אֲצִילוּת בְּרִיאָה יְצִירָה עֲשִׂיָּה. וִיהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, שֶׁיְּהֵא עַתָּה עֵת רָצוֹן לִהְיוֹת עוֹלָה מִצְוָה זוֹ לְפָנֶֽיךָ:

parts.gloss: Kabbalistic intention for the first night
Kabbalistic intention for the first night
parts.text: וּבְכֹֽחַ מִצְוָה זוֹ יִמָּשֵׁךְ הַחֶסֶד הַפְּנִימִי הָעֶלְיוֹן הַנִּקְרָא יוֹמָם,

יוֹמָא דְּכָלִיל לְכֻלְּהוּ יוֹמֵי שֶׁהוּא הַחֶֽסֶד שֶׁבַּחֶֽסֶד מֵאִמָּֽא עִלָּאָה לְרָחֵל אִמֵּֽנוּ. וְגַם תְּקַבֵּל עוֹד רָחֵל אִמֵּֽנוּ הַחֶֽסֶד הָעֶלְיוֹן שֶׁבְּכָל-הַחֲסָדִים דְּאוֹר מַקִּיף מֵאִמָּֽא עִלָּאָה קַדִּישָׁא שֶׁהוּא הַחֶֽסֶד שֶׁבַּחֶֽסֶד שֶׁבָּהּ:

parts.gloss: Kabbalistic intention for the second night
Kabbalistic intention for the second night
parts.text: וּבְכֹֽחַ מִצְוָה זוֹ יִמָּשֵׁךְ לְרָחֵל אִמֵּֽנוּ אוֹר הַמַקִּיף הַחֶֽסֶד שֶׁבַּגְּבוּרָה מֵאִמָּֽא עִלָּאָה קַדִּישָׁא:

parts.gloss: Kabbalistic intention for the third night
Kabbalistic intention for the third night
parts.text: וּבְכֹֽחַ מִצְוָה זוֹ יִמָּשֵׁךְ לְרָחֵל אִמֵּֽנוּ אוֹר הַמַּקִּיף הַחֶֽסֶד שֶׁבַּתִּפְאֶֽרֶת מֵאִמָּֽא עִלָּאָה קַדִּישָׁא:

parts.gloss: Kabbalistic intention for the fourth night
Kabbalistic intention for the fourth night
parts.text: וּבְכֹֽחַ מִצְוָה זוֹ יִמָּשֵׁךְ לְרָחֵל אִמֵּֽנוּ אוֹר הַמַקִּיף הַחֶֽסֶד שֶׁבַּנֶּֽצַח מֵאִמָּֽא עִלָּאָה קַדִּישָׁא:

parts.gloss: Kabbalistic intention for the fifth night
Kabbalistic intention for the fifth night
parts.text: וּבְכֹֽחַ מִצְוָה זוֹ יִמָּשֵׁךְ לְרָחֵל אִמֵּֽנוּ אוֹר הַמַקִּיף הַחֶֽסֶד שֶׁבַּהוֹד מֵאִמָּֽא עִלָּאָה קַדִּישָׁא:

parts.gloss: Kabbalistic intention for the sixth night
Kabbalistic intention for the sixth night
parts.text: וּבְכֹֽחַ מִצְוָה זוֹ יִמָּשֵׁךְ לְרָחֵל אִמֵּֽנוּ אוֹר הַמַקִּיף כְּלָלוּת הַחֲמִשָּׁה חֲסָדִים שֶׁבַּיְּסוֹד מֵאִמָּֽא עִלָּאָה קַדִּישָׁא.

parts.gloss: Kabbalistic intention for the seventh night
Kabbalistic intention for the seventh night
parts.text: וּבְכֹֽחַ מִצְוָה זוֹ יִמָּשֵׁךְ לְרָחֵל אִמֵּֽנוּ אוֹר הַמַקִּיף כְּלָלוּת הַחֲמִשָּׁה חֲסָדִים שֶׁבַּמַּלְכוּת מֵאִמָּֽא עִלָּאָה קַדִּישָׁא:

segs.gloss: Kabbalistic intention for dwelling in the Sukkah
segs.text: וְהוּכַן בַּחֶֽסֶד כִּסֵּא וְיִתְמַתְּקוּ הַגְּבוּרוֹת וְיִתְבַּסְּמוּ. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר, וִימִינ֖וֹ תְּחַבְּקֵֽנִי. וְהִנֵּה אֲנַֽחְנוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּנֵי מְלָכִים בְּנֵי הַמַּלְכוּת רָחֵל עֲקֶרֶת הַבַּיִת, עָשִֽׂינוּ הַסֻּכָּה כְּמִצְוַת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ אֲשֶׁר הִיא כְּנֶֽגֶד עַנְנֵי כָבוֹד. כַּכָּתוּב וַעֲנַ֧ן יְהֹוָ֛ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם יוֹמָ֑ם. וְהֵם שִׁבְעָה עֲנָנִים, וּכְנֶגְדָּם הֵם שִׁבְעַת יְמֵי הַסֻּכָּה, וְהִנֵּה אֲנַֽחְנוּ יוֹשְׁבִים בְּצֵל אוֹר הַמַקִּיף הַמִּתְפַּשֵּׁט עָלֶֽיהָ הַמַּקִּיף וְסוֹבֵב אוֹתָהּ, וּבִישִׁיבָתֵֽנוּ בָהּ יִמָּשֵׁךְ אֵלֵֽינוּ מִן-הָאוֹר הַמַקִּיף הַהוּא:

אָבִינוּ אָב הָרַחְמָן פְּרוֹשׂ עָלֵֽינוּ סֻכַּת שְׁלוֹמֶֽךָ, וְתַקְּנֵֽנוּ בְּעֵצָה טוֹבָה מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ, וּבְצֵל כְּנָפֶֽיךָ תַּסְתִּירֵֽנוּ, וּשְׁמוֹר צֵאתֵֽנוּ וּבוֹאֵֽנוּ לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם. וְיִתְקַיֵּם בָּֽנוּ מִקְרָא שֶׁכָּתוּב עַל-יְדֵי דָּוִד מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל. יְהֹוָ֥ה שֹׁמְרֶ֑ךָ יְהֹוָ֥ה צִ֝לְּךָ֗ עַל־יַ֥ד יְמִינֶֽךָ: כִּֽי־הָיִ֣יתָ עֶזְרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י וּבְצֵ֖ל כְּנָפֶ֣יךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן: וְיִתְקַיֵּם בָּֽנוּ מִקְרָא שֶׁכָּתוּב עַל-יְדֵי הוֹשֵֽׁעַ הַנָּבִיא. יָשֻׁ֙בוּ֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י בְצִלּ֔וֹ יְחַיּ֥וּ דָגָ֖ן וְיִפְרְח֣וּ כַגָּ֑פֶן: וְיִתְקַיֵּם בָּֽנוּ מִקְרָא שֶׁכָּתוּב עַל-יְדֵי יְשַׁעְיָה הַנָּבִיא. וָאָשִׂ֤ים דְּבָרַי֙ בְּפִ֔יךָ וּבְצֵ֥ל יָדִ֖י כִּסִּיתִ֑יךָ לִנְטֹ֤עַ שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְלִיסֹ֣ד אָ֔רֶץ וְלֵאמֹ֥ר לְצִיּ֖וֹן עַמִּי־אָֽתָּה׃

segs.en: Acrostic of the Tetragrammaton
segs.text: <small>ר"ת הוי"ה</small>

parts.gloss: Verse for the first letter of the Tetragrammaton

parts.text: [שִׁיר֣וֹ] עִמִּ֑י תְּ֝פִלָּ֗ה לְאֵ֣ל חַיָּֽי׃ הַרְאֵ֣נוּ יְהֹוָ֣ה חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝יֶשְׁעֲךָ֗ תִּתֶּן־לָֽנוּ׃

segs.gloss: Verse for the second letter of the Tetragrammaton
segs.text: וְחֶ֤סֶד יְהֹוָ֨ה ׀ מֵעוֹלָ֣ם וְעַד־ע֭וֹלָם עַל־יְרֵאָ֑יו וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ לִבְנֵ֥י בָנִֽים׃

segs.gloss: Verse for the third letter of the Tetragrammaton
segs.text: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

segs.en: Acrostic of Ehyeh
segs.text: <small>ר"ת אהיה</small>

segs.gloss: Verse for the first letter of Ehyeh
segs.text: אֹ֭הֵב צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט חֶ֥סֶד יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
ה֭וֹדוּ לְאֵ֣ל הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
יְהִי־חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֣ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר יִחַ֥לְנוּ לָֽךְ׃
הִנֵּ֤ה עֵ֣ין יְ֭הֹוָה אֶל־יְרֵאָ֑יו לַֽמְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ׃

segs.en: Acrostic of Adonay
segs.text: <small>ר"ת אדני</small>
אַתָּ֤ה יְהֹוָ֗ה לֹֽא־תִכְלָ֣א רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּ֑נִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ תָּמִ֥יד יִצְּרֽוּנִי׃
דִּמִּ֣ינוּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ בְּ֝קֶ֗רֶב הֵיכָלֶֽךָ׃
נָחִ֥יתָ בְחַסְדְּךָ֖ עַם־ז֣וּ גָּאָ֑לְתָּ נֵהַ֥לְתָּ בְעׇזְּךָ֖ אֶל־נְוֵ֥ה קׇדְשֶֽׁךָ׃
יְהֹוָה֮ יִגְמֹ֢ר בַּ֫עֲדִ֥י יְ֭הֹוָה חַסְדְּךָ֣ לְעוֹלָ֑ם מַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אַל־תֶּֽרֶף׃

אֵל מָלֵא רַחֲמִים, פְּרוֹשׂ עָלֵֽינוּ סֻכַּת רַחֲמִים וְשָׁלוֹם. כִּי אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הַפּוֹרֵשׂ סֻכַּת שָׁלוֹם עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל-כָּל-יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל- יְרוּשָׁלַֽיִם עִיר הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ תִּבָּנֶה וְתִכּוֹנֵן בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵֽינוּ אָמֵן:
עֽוּלוּ אוּשְׁפִּיזִין עִלָּאִין קַדִּישִׁין. עֽוּלוּ אֲבָהָן עִלָּאִין קַדִּישִׁין לְמִיתַב בְּצִלָּא דִמְהֵימְנוּתָֽא עִלָּאָה. בְּצִלָּא דְקֻדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא:

parts.text: <small>(דהכי סליק לחושבן סוכ"ה סמ"ך גי' ק"ב, וא"ו גי' י"ג, כ"ף גי' ק', ה"י גי' ט"ו, סך הכל גי' אברהם).</small>
וְלִיעוּל עִמֵּהּ יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן יוֹסֵף וְדָוִד.
<small>(דהכי סליק לחושבן סוכ"ה בא"ת ב"ש, ח'פ'ל'צ' עולה ר"ח, גי' יצחק).</small>
וְלִיעוּל עִמֵּהּ אַבְרָהָם יַעֲקֹב מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן יוֹסֵף וְדָוִד.
<small>(דהכי סליק ב' פעמים סוכ"ה גי' יעקב, וגם אותיות שלפני סוכה הוא נ'ה'י'ד', ואותיות שאחרי סוכה ע'ע'ל'ו', עולה קפ"ב גי' יעקב).</small>
וְלִיעוּל עִמֵּהּ אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן יוֹסֵף וְדָוִד:

<small>(דהכי סליק לחושבן סוכ"ה פשוטה ומלאה במלוי דיודי"ן סוכ"ה סמ"ך וי"ו כ"ף ה"י גי' משה וג' אותיות. וגם אם תחשוב א"ב ג"ד ה"ו ז"ח ט"י כ"ל מ"ן ס , גי' רנ"ה, א"ב ג"ד ה"ו ז"ח ט"י כ' הרי גי' ע"ה , א"ב ג"ד ה' הרי גי' ט"ו, סך הכל גי' משה).</small>
וְלִיעוּל עִמֵּהּ אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב וְאַהֲרֹן יוֹסֵף וְדָוִד.
<small>(דהכי סליק לחושבן סוכ"ה סמ"ך גי' ק"כ, וי"ו גי' כ"ב, כ"ף גי' ק', ה"י גי' ט"ו, סך הכל גי' אהרן ע"ה).</small>
וְלִיעוּל עִמֵּהּ אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב מֹשֶׁה יוֹסֵף וְדָוִד.
<small>(דהכי סליק מלוי סוכ"ה לבד כזה, מ"כ גי' ס', ו' גי' ו', פ' גי' פ', י' גי' י', סך הכל קנ"ו גי' יוסף).</small>
וְלִיעוּל עִמֵּהּ אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וְדָוִד.

parts.gloss: For the seventh night of Sukkot
Invocation for David the Messiah

parts.en: (Gematria explanation: Sukkah letters sum to David's name.)
parts.gloss: Kabbalistic gematria note
parts.text: <small>(דהכי סליק סכ"ה במספר קטן ס' גי' ו', כ' גי' ב', ה' גי' ה', והכולל הכי י"ד, גי' דוד. גם ב"פ סוכה וח' אותיות גי' ק"ץ כמנין דוד הוא הקטן).</small>

parts.gloss: Invocation for the other six Ushpizin
parts.text: וְלִיעוּל עִמֵּהּ אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וְיוֹסֵף.

segs.text: בַּסֻּכֹּ֥ת תֵּשְׁב֖וּ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים, תִּיבוּ אוּשְׁפִּיזִין עִלָּאִין קַדִּישִׁין. תִּיבוּ אֲבָהָן עִלָּאִין קַדִּישִׁין, לְמִיתַב בְּצִלָּא דִמְהֵימְנוּתָא עִלָּאָה. בְּצִלָּא דְקֻדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא: זַכָּאָה חֳלָקָנָא וְזַכָּאָה חֳלָקְהוֹן דְּיִשְׂרָאֶל. דִּכְתִיב כִּ֛י חֵ֥לֶק יְהֹוָ֖ה עַמּ֑וֹ יַעֲקֹ֖ב חֶ֥בֶל נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃

segs.en: Then sit in the Sukkah and say (in the language of the Sages):
segs.gloss: Instruction to recite the following verses in the Sukkah
segs.text: <small>אח"כ ישב בסוכה ויאמר <small>(מלשון חכמים)</small></small>

parts.gloss: For the first night of Sukkot
Verse about Abraham
parts.text: וְאַבְרָהָ֣ם זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּיָּמִ֑ים וַֽיהֹוָ֛ה בֵּרַ֥ךְ אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֖ם בַּכֹּֽל׃

parts.gloss: Repeat the verse seven times
For the second night of Sukkot
Verse about Isaac
parts.text: וַיִּזְרַ֤ע יִצְחָק֙ בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַהִ֔וא וַיִּמְצָ֛א בַּשָּׁנָ֥ה הַהִ֖וא מֵאָ֣ה שְׁעָרִ֑ים וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֖הוּ יְהֹוָֽה׃

parts.gloss: Repeat the verse seven times
For the third night of Sukkot
Verse about Jacob
Repeat the verse seven times
For the fourth night of Sukkot
Verse about Moses (Torah)
parts.text: תּוֹרָ֥ה צִוָּה־לָ֖נוּ מֹשֶׁ֑ה מוֹרָשָׁ֖ה קְהִלַּ֥ת יַעֲקֹֽב׃

parts.gloss: Repeat the verse three times
Verse about Moses (humility)
parts.text: וְהָאִ֥ישׁ מֹשֶׁ֖ה עָנָ֣ו מְאֹ֑ד מִכֹּל֙ הָֽאָדָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃

parts.gloss: Repeat the verse three times
Verse about Moses (prophethood)
parts.text: וְלֹֽא־קָ֨ם נָבִ֥יא ע֛וֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כְּמֹשֶׁ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יְדָע֣וֹ יְהֹוָ֔ה פָּנִ֖ים אֶל־פָּנִֽים׃

parts.gloss: Repeat the verse three times
For the fifth night of Sukkot
Verses about Aaron and the Priestly Blessing
parts.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ דַּבֵּ֤ר אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶל־בָּנָ֣יו לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֥ה תְבָרְכ֖וּ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אָמ֖וֹר לָהֶֽם׃ יְבָרֶכְךָ֥ יְהֹוָ֖ה וְיִשְׁמְרֶֽךָ׃ יָאֵ֨ר יְהֹוָ֧ה ׀ פָּנָ֛יו אֵלֶ֖יךָ וִֽיחֻנֶּֽךָּ׃ יִשָּׂ֨א יְהֹוָ֤ה ׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃ וְשָׂמ֥וּ אֶת־שְׁמִ֖י עַל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַאֲנִ֖י אֲבָרְכֵֽם׃

parts.gloss: Repeat the verses three times
For the sixth night of Sukkot
Verse about Joseph (wealth)
parts.text: וַיִּצְבֹּ֨ר יוֹסֵ֥ף בָּ֛ר כְּח֥וֹל הַיָּ֖ם הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד עַ֛ד כִּי־חָדַ֥ל לִסְפֹּ֖ר כִּי־אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃

parts.gloss: Repeat the verse three times
Verse about Joseph (blessing)
parts.text: בֵּ֤ן פֹּרָת֙ יוֹסֵ֔ף בֵּ֥ן פֹּרָ֖ת עֲלֵי־עָ֑יִן בָּנ֕וֹת צָעֲדָ֖ה עֲלֵי־שֽׁוּר׃

parts.gloss: Repeat the verse three times
Verse about Joseph (blessing continued)
parts.text: וּלְיוֹסֵ֣ף אָמַ֔ר מְבֹרֶ֥כֶת יְהֹוָ֖ה אַרְצ֑וֹ מִמֶּ֤גֶד שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ מִטָּ֔ל וּמִתְּה֖וֹם רֹבֶ֥צֶת תָּֽחַת׃ וּמִמֶּ֖גֶד תְּבוּאֹ֣ת שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וּמִמֶּ֖גֶד גֶּ֥רֶשׁ יְרָחִֽים׃ וּמֵרֹ֖אשׁ הַרְרֵי־קֶ֑דֶם וּמִמֶּ֖גֶד גִּבְע֥וֹת עוֹלָֽם׃ וּמִמֶּ֗גֶד אֶ֚רֶץ וּמְלֹאָ֔הּ וּרְצ֥וֹן שֹׁכְנִ֖י סְנֶ֑ה תָּב֙וֹאתָה֙ לְרֹ֣אשׁ יוֹסֵ֔ף וּלְקׇדְקֹ֖ד נְזִ֥יר אֶחָֽיו׃

parts.gloss: Repeat the verse three times
For the seventh night of Sukkot
Verse about David
parts.text: וַיְהִ֥י דָוִ֛ד לְכׇל־דְּרָכָ֖ו מַשְׂכִּ֑יל וַיהֹוָ֖ה עִמּֽוֹ׃

parts.gloss: Repeat the verse three times

parts.text: [מִגְדּ֖וֹל] יְשׁוּע֣וֹת מַלְכּ֑וֹ וְעֹֽשֶׂה־חֶ֧סֶד לִמְשִׁיח֛וֹ לְדָוִ֥ד וּלְזַרְע֖וֹ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

segs.en: Some have the custom to say these verses in the Sukkah.
segs.text: <small>יש נוהגים לומר פסוקים אלה בסוכה</small>

parts.gloss: Said on the first night of Sukkot

parts.text: שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה חַלְּצָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י ה֝וֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃ יְהִי־חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֣ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר יִחַ֥לְנוּ לָֽךְ׃ ק֭וּמָֽה עֶזְרָ֣תָה לָּ֑נוּ וּ֝פְדֵ֗נוּ לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ:

parts.gloss: Said on the second night of Sukkot

parts.text: עוֹרְרָ֥ה אֶת־גְּבוּרָתֶ֑ךָ וּלְכָ֖ה לִישֻׁעָ֣תָה לָּֽנוּ׃ וְגַ֤ם עַד־זִקְנָ֨ה ׀ וְשֵׂיבָה֮ אֱלֹהִ֢ים אַֽל־תַּ֫עַזְבֵ֥נִי עַד־אַגִּ֣יד זְרוֹעֲךָ֣ לְד֑וֹר לְכׇל־יָ֝ב֗וֹא גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ׃ לְךָ֣ זְ֭רוֹעַ עִם־גְּבוּרָ֑ה תָּעֹ֥ז יָ֝דְךָ֗ תָּר֥וּם יְמִינֶֽךָ׃ עַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֤י הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ ׀ יְהֹוָ֗ה מְשִׁ֫יח֥וֹ יַ֭עֲנֵהוּ מִשְּׁמֵ֣י קׇדְשׁ֑וֹ בִּ֝גְבֻר֗וֹת יֵ֣שַׁע יְמִינֽוֹ׃

parts.gloss: Said on the third night of Sukkot

parts.text: תִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭רֹאשְׁךָ לִוְיַת־חֵ֑ן עֲטֶ֖רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת תְּמַגְּנֶֽךָּ׃ כִּי־תִפְאֶ֣רֶת עֻזָּ֣מוֹ אָ֑תָּה וּ֝בִרְצוֹנְךָ֗

[תָּר֥וּם] קַרְנֵֽינוּ׃ עוּרִ֥י עוּרִ֛י לִבְשִׁ֥י עֻזֵּ֖ךְ צִיּ֑וֹן לִבְשִׁ֣י ׀ בִּגְדֵ֣י תִפְאַרְתֵּ֗ךְ יְרֽוּשָׁלַ֙‍ִם֙ עִ֣יר הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ: וּֽלְתִתְּךָ֣ עֶלְי֗וֹן עַ֤ל כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה לִתְהִלָּ֖ה וּלְשֵׁ֣ם וּלְתִפְאָ֑רֶת וְלִֽהְיֹתְךָ֧ עַם־קָדֹ֛שׁ לַיהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר׃

parts.gloss: Said on the fourth night of Sukkot

parts.text: יְהֹ֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֣וֹת הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נוּ הָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה׃ תּֽוֹדִיעֵנִי֮ אֹ֤רַח חַ֫יִּ֥ים שֹׂ֣בַע שְׂ֭מָחוֹת אֶת־פָּנֶ֑יךָ נְעִמ֖וֹת בִּימִינְךָ֣ נֶֽצַח׃

parts.gloss: Said on the fifth night of Sukkot

parts.text: יְהֹוָ֤ה אֲדֹנֵ֗ינוּ מָֽה־אַדִּ֣יר שִׁ֭מְךָ בְּכָל־הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּנָ֥ה ה֝וֹדְךָ֗ עַל־הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃ גָּד֣וֹל כְּ֭בוֹדוֹ בִּישׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ ה֥וֹד וְ֝הָדָר תְּשַׁוֶּ֥ה עָלָֽיו׃ וְהִשְׁמִ֨יעַ יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶת־ה֣וֹד קוֹל֗וֹ וְנַ֤חַת זְרוֹעוֹ֙ יַרְאֶ֔ה:

parts.gloss: Said on the sixth night of Sukkot

parts.text: נִכְסְפָ֬ה וְגַם־כָּֽלְתָ֨ה ׀ נַפְשִׁי֮ לְחַצְר֢וֹת יְהֹ֫וָ֥ה לִבִּ֥י וּבְשָׂרִ֑י יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ אֶ֣ל אֵֽל־חָֽי׃ יָצָ֙אתָ֙ לְיֵ֣שַׁע עַמֶּ֔ךָ לְיֵ֖שַׁע אֶת־מְשִׁיחֶ֑ךָ מָחַ֤צְתָּ רֹּאשׁ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית רָשָׁ֔ע עָר֛וֹת יְס֥וֹד עַד־צַוָּ֖אר סֶֽלָה׃

parts.gloss: Said on the seventh night of Sukkot (Hoshana Raba)

parts.text: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי ט֣וֹב וְסַלָּ֑ח וְרַב־חֶ֗֝סֶד לְכׇל־קֹֽרְאֶֽיךָ׃ מַֽלְכוּתְךָ֗ מַלְכ֥וּת כׇּל־עֹלָמִ֑ים וּ֝מֶֽמְשַׁלְתְּךָ֗ בְּכׇל־דּ֥וֹר וָדֹֽר׃ וְהָיָ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־כׇּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִהְיֶ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶחָ֖ד וּשְׁמ֥וֹ אֶחָֽד׃ לְךָ֣ יְ֠הֹוָ֠ה הַגְּדֻלָּ֨ה וְהַגְּבוּרָ֤ה וְהַתִּפְאֶ֙רֶת֙ וְהַנֵּ֣צַח וְהַה֔וֹד כִּי־כֹ֖ל בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם וּבָאָ֑רֶץ לְךָ֤ יְהֹוָה֙ הַמַּמְלָכָ֔ה וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂ֖א לְכֹ֥ל ׀ לְרֹֽאשׁ׃

segs.en: On every night after saying Ushpizin, place your hands on the seat where holy books are placed and say:
segs.text: <small>בכל לילה אחרי אמירת עולו אושפיזין ישים ידיו על הכסה שמוניחים עליו ספרי קודש ויאמר </small>
זה הכסה של שבעה אושפיזין עילאין קדישין זיע"א

For the sake of the unification of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah, in fear and love, and love and fear, to unify the Name Yud-Kei with Vav-Kei in perfect unity, in the name of all Israel, and in the name of all the nefashot, ruchot, and neshamot that are related to the roots of our nefesh, ruach, and neshamah and their garments and those close to them, from the totality of Atzilut, Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah, and from all the particulars of Atzilut, Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah, of every partzuf and sefirah of the particulars of Atzilut, Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah: behold, we are coming to fulfill the positive commandment of dwelling in the sukkah, as Hashem our God commanded us in His holy Torah by the hand of Moses our teacher, peace be upon him: “You shall dwell in booths for seven days; every native in Israel shall dwell in booths, so that your generations will know that I made the children of Israel dwell in booths when I brought them out of the land of Egypt.” To repair the root of this commandment in the supernal place; to do the intention of our Creator, Who commanded us to perform this commandment; to complete the supernal Tree and raise up the fallen sukkah of David, to restore the crown to its former place; and to complete the perfect repair of the nefashot, ruchot, and neshamot from the totality of Atzilut, Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah, and from all the particulars of Atzilut, Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah. May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that this be now a time of favor for this commandment to ascend before You.

parts.text: The first night: And with the power of this commandment,
by day – the day that includes all days,
which is Kindness within Kindness – be drawn from the supernal Mother to our mother,
also receive the supernal kindness from all of the kindnesses of the surrounding light from the supernal holy Mother,
which is Kindness within Kindness that is in Her.
The second night: And with the power of this commandment,
may the light surrounding the Kindness within Strength [
] be drawn from the supernal holy Mother to our mother,
The third night: And with the power of this commandment,
may the light surrounding the Kindness within Splendor [
] be drawn from the supernal holy Mother to our mother,
The fourth night: And with the power of this commandment,
may the light surrounding the Kindness within Eternity [
] be drawn from the supernal holy Mother to our mother,
The fifth night: And with the power of this commandment,
may the light surrounding the Kindness within Majesty [
] be drawn from the supernal holy Mother to our mother,
The sixth night: And with the power of this commandment,
may the light surrounding the aggregate of the five kindnesses within the Foundation [
] be drawn from the supernal holy Mother to our mother,
The seventh night: And with the power of this commandment,
may the light surrounding the aggregate of the five kindnesses within Kinghood [
] be drawn from the supernal holy Mother to our mother,
So the throne has been established with Kindness,
such that the strengths are sweetened and perfumed. And it is as it is stated:
(Song of Sons 2:6). And behold we are Israel,
Rachel the mainstay of the house – we have fulfilled sukkah like the commandment of the Lord our God,
which corresponds to the clouds of glory,
And the cloud of the Lord was upon them by day
(Numbers 10:34). And those are the seven clouds;
corresponding to the seven days of the sukkah. And behold,
we are sitting in the shade of the surrounding light which extends over it,
which surrounds it and encircles it. And when we sit in it,
may some of that surrounding light be drawn to us.

segs.text: Our Father, merciful Father, spread over us the sukkah of Your peace, set us right with good counsel from before You, hide us in the shadow of Your wings, and guard our going out and our coming in, for good life and for peace. And may there be fulfilled in us the verse written by David, king of Israel: “Hashem is your guardian; Hashem is your shade at your right hand.” “For You have been my help, and in the shadow of Your wings I sing.” And may there be fulfilled in us the verse written by Hosea the prophet: “Those who dwell in his shade shall live; they shall grow grain and blossom like the vine.” And may there be fulfilled in us the verse written by Isaiah the prophet: “I have put My words in your mouth and covered you with the shadow of My hand, to plant the heavens and to lay the foundations of the earth, and to say to Zion: You are My people.”
By day Hashem commands His kindness, and at night His song is with me, a prayer to the God of my life. Show us Your kindness, Hashem, and grant us Your salvation.
But the kindness of Hashem is from everlasting to everlasting upon those who fear Him, and His righteousness to children’s children.
Give thanks to Hashem, for He is good; His kindness is forever.
He loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of the kindness of Hashem.
Give thanks to the God of heaven, for His kindness is forever.
May Your kindness, Hashem, be upon us, as we have hoped in You.
Behold, the eye of Hashem is upon those who fear Him, upon those who hope for His kindness.
You, Hashem, will not withhold Your mercies from me; Your kindness and Your truth will always guard me.
We have thought of Your kindness, O God, in the midst of Your Temple.
In Your kindness You led the people You redeemed; in Your strength You guided them to Your holy abode.
Hashem will accomplish it for me; Hashem, Your kindness is forever; do not forsake the works of Your hands.

God, full of mercy, spread over us the sukkah of mercy and peace. For You, Hashem, are the One Who spreads the sukkah of peace over us, over all Israel, and over Jerusalem, the holy city. May it be built and established speedily in our days. Amen.
Enter, exalted holy guests. Enter, exalted holy fathers, to dwell in the shade of supreme faith, in the shade of the Holy One, blessed be He.
May Abraham, beloved, holy father, enter. And may there enter with him Isaac, Jacob, Moses, Aaron, Joseph, and David.
May Isaac, the bound one, holy father, enter. And may there enter with him Abraham, Jacob, Moses, Aaron, Joseph, and David.
May Jacob, the perfect one, holy father, enter. And may there enter with him Abraham, Isaac, Moses, Aaron, Joseph, and David.
May Moses, the faithful shepherd, enter. And may there enter with him Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Aaron, Joseph, and David.
May Aaron, the great and holy kohen, enter. And may there enter with him Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Moses, Joseph, and David.
May Joseph, the righteous, enter. And may there enter with him Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Moses, Aaron, and David.
May David, the king Messiah, enter. And may there enter with him Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Moses, Aaron, and Joseph.

“You shall dwell in booths for seven days.” Be seated, exalted holy guests; be seated, exalted holy fathers, to dwell in the shade of supreme faith, in the shade of the Holy One, blessed be He. Happy is our portion, and happy is the portion of Israel, as it is written: “For Hashem’s portion is His people; Jacob is the lot of His inheritance.”
And Abraham was old, advanced in years, and Hashem blessed Abraham in all things.
And Isaac sowed in that land, and in that year he found a hundredfold, and Hashem blessed him.
How good are your tents, Jacob, your dwelling places, Israel.
Moses commanded us the Torah, an inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
Now the man Moses was very humble, more than any person on the face of the earth.
And no prophet has arisen since in Israel like Moses, whom Hashem knew face to face.

And Hashem spoke to Moses, saying: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying: Thus shall you bless the children of Israel; say to them: May Hashem bless you and protect you. May Hashem make His face shine upon you and be gracious to you. May Hashem lift up His face to you and grant you peace. And they shall place My Name upon the children of Israel, and I will bless them.
And Joseph stored up grain like the sand of the sea, in great abundance, until he stopped counting, for it could not be counted.
Joseph is a fruitful bough, a fruitful bough by a spring; its branches run over the wall.

And of Joseph he said: Blessed of Hashem be his land, with the choicest gifts of heaven, with dew, and with the deep that lies beneath; with the choicest fruits of the sun, and the choicest yield of the months; with the finest produce of the ancient mountains, and the choicest gifts of the everlasting hills; with the choicest gifts of the earth and its fullness, and the favor of Him Who dwelt in the bush. May they come upon the head of Joseph, on the crown of the one set apart from his brothers.
And David was successful in all his ways, and Hashem was with him.
He gives great salvation to His king and shows kindness to His anointed, to David and to his descendants forever.
Return, Hashem, rescue my soul; save me for the sake of Your kindness. May Your kindness, Hashem, be upon us, as we have hoped in You. Arise, be our help, and redeem us for the sake of Your kindness.

Stir up Your might and come to save us. Even to old age and gray hair, O God, do not forsake me, until I declare Your arm to the generation, Your might to all who are to come. Yours is an arm with might; strong is Your hand, Your right hand is exalted. Now I know that Hashem saves His anointed; He will answer him from His holy heavens with the saving might of His right hand.

She will place on your head a graceful garland; a crown of glory she will bestow upon you. For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is exalted. Awake, awake, put on your strength, O Zion; put on your garments of splendor, Jerusalem, the holy city. And that He will set you high above all the nations that He has made, for praise, for fame, and for glory; and that you will be a holy people to Hashem your God, as He has spoken.
Hashem God of hosts, restore us; cause Your face to shine, that we may be saved. You make known to me the path of life; in Your presence is fullness of joy, in Your right hand eternal delights.

Hashem, our Lord, how mighty is Your Name in all the earth, You who set Your splendor above the heavens. Great is his glory through Your salvation; splendor and majesty You bestow upon him. And Hashem will make His glorious voice heard and will show the descent of His arm.

My soul yearns, even faints, for the courts of Hashem; my heart and my flesh sing for joy to the living God. You went out for the salvation of Your people, for the salvation of Your anointed; You struck the head from the house of the wicked, laying bare from foundation to neck, Selah.

For You, my Lord, are good and forgiving, and abundant in kindness to all who call on You. Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Your dominion is throughout all generations. And Hashem shall be King over all the earth; on that day Hashem shall be One and His Name One. Yours, Hashem, are the greatness, the might, the splendor, the victory, and the majesty, for all that is in heaven and on earth; Yours, Hashem, is the kingdom, and You are exalted as head over all.
This is the seat of the seven exalted holy guests. May their merit protect us. Amen.

שְׁמִינִי חַג עֲצֶֽרֶת הַזֶּה, אֶת יוֹם טוֹב מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ הַזֶּה, זְמַן שִׂמְחָתֵֽנוּ

בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְשָׂשׂוֹן הִנְחַלְתָּֽנוּ: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה,

<small>בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, הַמַּבְדִּיל בֵּין קֹֽדֶשׁ לְחֹל, וּבֵין אוֹר לְחֹֽשֶׁךְ, וּבֵין יִשְׂרָאֵל לָעַמִּים, וּבֵין יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי לְשֵֽׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה, בֵּין קְדֻשַּׁת שַׁבָּת לִקְדֻשַּׁת יוֹם טוֹב הִבְדַּֽלְתָּ, וְאֶת יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִשֵּֽׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הִקְדַּֽשְׁתָּ וְהִבְדַּֽלְתָּ, וְהִקְדַּֽשְׁתָּ אֶת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּקְדֻשָּׁתָךְ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה, הַמַּבְדִּיל בֵּין קֹֽדֶשׁ לְקֹֽדֶשׁ:</small>

segs.text: <small>בליל שני של סוכות אומרים תחלה שהחינו ואחר כך לישב בסוכה</small>
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו, וְצִוָּֽנוּ לֵישֵׁב בַּסֻּכָּה:
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, שֶׁהֶחֱיָֽנוּ וְקִיְּמָֽנוּ וְהִגִּיעָֽנוּ לַזְּמַן הַזֶּה:
“These are the appointed times of Hashem, holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed times.” And Moses declared the appointed times of Hashem to the children of Israel.
With your permission, my masters. To life!
Blessed are You, Hashem our God, King of the universe, Who creates the fruit of the vine.

parts.text: Blessed are You, Hashem our God, King of the universe, Who has chosen us from every people, exalted us above every tongue, and sanctified us with His commandments. And You gave us, Hashem our God, with love,
festivals for joy, holidays and seasons for gladness, the day of
this Sabbath day and the day of

segs.text: this Festival of Shavuot, this Yom Tov, a holy convocation, the season of the giving of our Torah.
this Festival of Sukkot, this Yom Tov, a holy convocation, the season of our rejoicing.
this Eighth Day, the Festival of Assembly, this Yom Tov, a holy convocation, the season of our rejoicing.

parts.text: with love, a holy convocation in remembrance of the Exodus from Egypt. For You have chosen us and sanctified us above all the peoples,
with gladness and joy You have given us as an inheritance. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who sanctifies

segs.text: Blessed are You, Hashem our God, King of the universe, Who creates the lights of the fire.

Blessed are You, Hashem our God, King of the universe, Who distinguishes between holy and profane, between light and darkness, between Israel and the nations, between the seventh day and the six days of work. You have distinguished between the holiness of Shabbat and the holiness of Yom Tov, and You sanctified the seventh day above the six days of work; You distinguished and sanctified Your people Israel with Your holiness. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who distinguishes between holy and holy.
Blessed are You, Hashem our God, King of the universe, Who has sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us to dwell in the sukkah.
Blessed are You, Hashem our God, King of the universe, Who has kept us alive, sustained us, and brought us to this season.
